## What's new

**🙈 Hidden people are listed in the room again**
- When a room shows up because of other friends, people on your Hidden list are no longer collapsed into "1 hidden person" at the bottom. They're listed with everyone else, with their **FRIEND** tag and a **HIDDEN** tag next to their name.
- Hidden people still don't bring a room into the list on their own, aren't shown under "Here because of", and don't count in the badge.

## Update

Vencord: click the new-version notification on Windows or macOS, or download `FriendsInVoice-v1.17.0.zip` and run `install.bat` on Windows or `install.command` / `bash install.sh` on macOS.

BetterDiscord: replace your plugin file with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release.

## Verification

All 28 BetterDiscord port tests passed.
